# Anupubbābhisamayakathā (Kv 2.9)

**ID:** Kv 2.9
**Section:** Kathāvatthu (kv)
**Collection:** Abhidhamma
**Title (Pali):** Anupubbābhisamayakathā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/abh03m3.mul9.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

In contrast, rival schools maintained that adepts comprehend the truths and eradicate defilements stage by stage [Dutt 1945; Dutt 1978]. According to the *Kathāvatthu-aṭṭhakathā*, the doctrine of gradual realization was championed by the Andhakas, Sabbatthikas (Sarvāstivādins), Sammitiyas, and Bhadrayānikas [Hazra 2002; Ruegg, Buddha-nature].
